items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Procope and Paul. Of course you hadn't worked with Paul before.

ctx.x: Well, I'm just trying to think. Well, Procope and Paul. Of course you hadn't worked with Paul before. But anyway, it was still the band. Well, Cootie, right away, you made a record session which was wonderful. You made that "Afro Bossa Salsa".
